connectionSpecification.description: Reads Meta ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, business extended credits and daily ad insights from the Facebook Marketing API.

access_token.description: Long-lived user or system-user access token with the ads_read permission. It is sent in the Authorization header.
access_token.title: Access Token

account_ids.description: Ad accounts to read, with or without the act_ prefix.
account_ids.title: Ad Account IDs

business_ids.description: Businesses whose extended credits the business_extended_credits stream reads.
business_ids.title: Business IDs

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose insights are read; empty reads up to today.
end_date.title: End Date

graph_api_base_url.description: Replaces https://graph.facebook.com, for example to send requests through a proxy; the API version path is appended.
graph_api_base_url.title: Graph API Base URL

graph_api_headers.description: Headers sent with every Graph API request, for example for a proxy.
graph_api_headers.title: Extra Request Headers

lookback_days.description: Days before the saved date_start an incremental insights read starts again, since Meta still changes insights for about 28 days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose insights are read.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Facebook Marketing Source Spec
